svg.title: Root Canon AI system architecture
svg.text: Evidence grounded clinical decision support for UK dental surgery. Retrieval augmented generation over real, licensed sources.
Offline, resumable, licence aware. Streams hundreds of thousands of records.
SSE stream: meta, emergency, sources, tokens, final
Abstain when best evidence is weak
Deterministic clinical tools: numbers never come from the model
SDCEP regimens, LA maximum dose, adrenaline by age, interactions
